DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(col1 STRING)
SESSION	SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Hong_Kong'
SESSION	SET TIME ZONE 'GMT+1'
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL 10 HOURS
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL '15:40:32' HOUR TO SECOND
SESSION	SET TIME ZONE LOCAL
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE
SESSION	SET TIME ZONE 'invalid/zone'
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL 3 DAYS
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL 24 HOURS
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL '19:40:32' HOUR TO SECOND
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL 10 HOURS 'GMT+1'
PARSE_ERROR	SET TIME ZONE INTERVAL 10 HOURS 1 MILLISECOND
READ	SELECT NANVL(col1, NULL) FROM t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
